Manage Floating IPs

Usage:
  hcloud floating-ip [command]

Aliases:
  floating-ip, floating-ips

General:
  add-label          Add a label to a Floating IP
  create             Create a Floating IP
  delete             Delete a Floating IP
  describe           Describe a Floating IP
  list               List Floating IPs
  remove-label       Remove a label from a Floating IP
  update             Update a Floating IP

Protection:
  disable-protection Disable resource protection for a Floating IP
  enable-protection  Enable resource protection for a Floating IP

Assign:
  assign             Assign a Floating IP to a server
  unassign           Unassign a Floating IP

Additional Commands:
  set-rdns           Change reverse DNS of a Floating IP

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for floating-ip

Global Flags:
      --config string              Config file path (default "~/.config/hcloud/cli.toml")
      --context string             Currently active context
      --debug                      Enable debug output
      --debug-file string          File to write debug output to
      --endpoint string            Hetzner Cloud API endpoint (default "https://api.hetzner.cloud/v1")
      --hetzner-endpoint string    Hetzner API endpoint (default "https://api.hetzner.com/v1")
      --http-timeout duration      Timeout for HTTP requests (default 0 = no timeout)
      --no-experimental-warnings   If true, experimental warnings are not shown
      --poll-interval duration     Interval at which to poll information, for example action progress (default 500ms)
      --quiet                      If true, only print error messages

Use "hcloud floating-ip [command] --help" for more information about a command.
